name: print-social-indigo-swirl-background-phone-in-hand-scalloped-card-travel-ad
title: Trip Planner Ad with Scalloped Card
whatItIs: An indigo ad with faint swirl shapes, a white wordmark at the left, a wavy-edged white card holding a hand-held phone photo of a mobile site, a green magnifier button on its edge and the headline 'Find trips that fit your schedule' with a short line, plus a site line and social icons at the base.
whatItMeans: A soft wobbly card frames the product photo in a friendly way, and a green button gives the one moment of contrast.
techniques: Wavy-edged card like a soft frame
Hand-held phone as the hero image
Green magnifier button overlapping the edge

vocabulary.definition: A card with soft wavy edges.
A round button placed across a card's border.
Faint flowing shapes used as texture.
